name: agentmonitor-desktop
description: Native macOS, Windows and Linux desktop shell for Agent Monitor.
author: Tanveer Hoque <tanvoid0@gmail.com>

scripts.package: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dmg:arm64: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.dmg.title='Agent Monitor (Apple Silicon)'
scripts.dmg:x64: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config.dmg.title='Agent Monitor (Intel)'
scripts.dmg:universal: rm -rf release && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config.dmg.title='Agent Monitor (Universal)'
scripts.win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.win:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
